output.reason: The linked issue [ev-9241c3a1cc2b] states the subject and the conditions: the App -> Details -> Parameters UI page crashed for Applications with `sourceHydrator` configured. The reproduction manifest shows this, and the stack trace [ev-7a16e0c1dd56] shows the error was a null reference ("Cannot read properties of null (reading 'type')"). The PR [ev-8783c3b78743] states the change: it only stops the page from crashing and does not change how the parameters tab works with the hydrator or how editing works. It touches one UI file, application-parameters.tsx [ev-21b3aa16ca8b].
